newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH C.BANK BUYS DOLLARS AT PLN 3.0337 - 3.0360.
newsitem.headline: POLISH C.BANK BUYS DOLLARS AT PLN 3.0337 - 3.0360.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland bought dollars on the interbank forex market at 3.0337 zlotys and then at 3.0355 and 3.0360 zlotys, dealers said.
The intervention, described as "large," came at 1022 GMT, when the zloty was at average of 3.35 percent from the central weighted dollar and mark parity rates.
The NBP's last intervention came on January 24 when the bank bought dollars at 2.9830 zlotys or 2.64 percent from the parity.
Last week, the NBP's deputy head Witold Kozinski said he had been pleased with the zloty rate at around three percent from the trading band centre.
At 1035 the zloty plunged to 3.02/2.86 percent from the parity rate, down from opening's 3.64/3.55 percent.
